description: Employer-only proposal disposition (proposal_management.proposals.disposition; the family is DEFAULT-OFF via AGENT_SURFACE_PROPOSAL_MANAGEMENT_ENABLED). DECLINE → DECLINED, MAYBE → MAYBE, RESTORE returns a DECLINED proposal to its last safe audited prior status (UNREVIEWED/SHORTLISTED/MAYBE, else UNREVIEWED). CAS-pinned by expectedStatus (typed 409 STALE_PROPOSAL_STATUS on a lost race); HIRED, provider-managed RESUME_SENT, and active-contract proposals fail closed as typed 409s. Same idempotencyKey + payload replays the exact original outcome. Every applied transition appends an immutable audit event. Candidate self-access is never authority. Requires proposals:write scope.

expectedStatus.description: CAS pin: the mutation applies only while the row still holds this status.

idempotencyKey.description: Also sent as the Idempotency-Key header; same key + payload replays.

note.description: Optional bounded employer-private note; never candidate-readable.

name: opentrain_disposition_proposal
